parent: Phase-21 paired random rank sweep found rank 9 sufficient and ranks 5-8 insufficient under random nested projections
question: Can any structured rank-8 subspace of the 3x3 neighborhood preserve full transfer, and which single local spatial Fourier mode is dynamically critical when omitted?

spatial_basis.basis: fixed real orthonormal 3x3 discrete Fourier basis, identical for both state channels
spatial_basis.patch_coordinates: x,y in {-1,0,1} matching the frozen 3x3 stencil ordering
spatial_basis.construction: dc=1/3; each nonzero real Fourier cosine/sine mode uses sqrt(2/9) normalization for frequency representatives (1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)
spatial_basis.lodo_variants: nine variants; each removes the same named Fourier mode from both channels

identifier.recursive_state_projection: same frozen Phase-10 18-bit companded token representation after every predicted step

paired_design: Within each replicate, the full-rank control and all nine leave-one-out variants share exactly the same representation codebooks, physical evaluation trajectories, context and targets. Only the omitted fixed Fourier mode changes.
control_rule: The rank-9 full Fourier basis must pass all 45 registered cells. If it does not, Phase 22 is CONTROL_FAIL and leave-one-out sufficiency conclusions are not interpreted.
primary_rule: Conditional on the full-rank control passing, a leave-one-out variant is called sufficient only if all 45 registered cells beat persistence. A Fourier mode is operationally critical in this protocol if omitting it causes any registered failure. A mode is operationally dispensable only if its omission passes 45/45. All nine variants are evaluated; no posthoc mode replacement or basis rotation is allowed.
primary_outcomes: whether any structured rank-8 leave-one-out variant is sufficient
set of modes whose omission is sufficient
set of modes whose omission is critical under the frozen gate
secondary_diagnostics: per-split median ratio by omitted mode
worst registered cell by omitted mode
comparison with Phase-21 random rank-8 variability
failure_policy: All registered outcomes are retained. No consumed replicate is rerun or replaced. A passing omission cannot erase failures of other omissions. The full-rank control cannot be tuned after execution.
claim_limit: Synthetic known-law systems only. Fourier-mode omission identifies sensitivity within this fixed representation and simulator suite; it is not a universal decomposition of physical law, proof of minimal operator dimension, or discovery of new physics.
